svg.title: ANSIL — below deck
svg.desc: ANSIL becomes a pirate stage: a rope arrival, a flag on the I, and an officer chasing a pirate down the S. A blind swing fells the I and breaks the deck. Below, a stuck sword and a lit fuse cause a barrel blast. The shattered letters rebuild, and a surrender flag emerges from L.
